_doc: Who asks whom (owner-only; scripts/route.sh reads it, wake-agents fires the routines). A role's logins are its GitHub accounts; while agent identities are paused, agents post as the owner and a `<!-- role: x -->` marker names the role. A channel is an issue label. from/to: who may open it and who is woken; on_reply: who is woken when the owner comments; on_close: who is woken when it closes. A debate channel alternates between two roles, each gets at most `turns` turns, then `escalate_to` takes it to the owner. Add a role or channel here, plus its secret in wake-agents.yml.
